title: GTA 6 Physical Copies Arriving Without Codes or With Used Ones, Buyers Say
content:
Some players who picked up physical copies of Grand Theft Auto VI this week say their boxes arrived with no download code inside, or with a code that had already been redeemed. Because the boxed edition contains no disc, a missing or used code leaves them without a copy of the game four days before its 19 November launch. Reports have come from buyers in the US and Europe, and a fan account that tracks the game says Xbox owners are now affected as well as PlayStation owners. Rockstar Games has not commented publicly on the reports, and nobody knows yet how many copies are involved.

The timing makes the problem harder to ignore. Boxed copies went on sale at retailers on 12 November so that buyers could redeem their codes and start the 212GB pre-load ahead of launch. According to Rockstar’s support page , “codes can be used as soon as they are received”, which means anyone stuck with a dead box is already falling behind players who bought digitally.

Grand Theft Auto VI is now only one week away! Thank you to everyone in the community for your incredible support. There’s still time to pre-order and pre-load so you’re ready on launch day. Code-in-box versions are also available now for pick-up at retailers worldwide. pic.twitter.com/au3uAf6p5w

The complaints from buyers fall into two broad groups so far. Some buyers say they opened a sealed case and found an empty space, or a grey strip, where the code card should have been, according to GSMDome. Others say the code was there but had already been redeemed by someone else when they tried to use it. One social media post claimed that Rockstar support closed a ticket after a player reported a missing code, although that claim has not been verified.

A second theory explains how a sealed code could already be used. According to posts in a Reddit thread cited by TechJuice and GamingHQ, the code is printed on the case cover itself rather than on a separate insert. In PEGI regions such as the UK and Europe it is reportedly left fully exposed, while North American packaging obscures it. A fan account claimed on 13 November that the code could be read through the shrink-wrap with a strong light, which would let someone copy it and leave the box on the shelf. GSMDome notes that there is no evidence this is a common theft method, and none of the reports shows a widespread manufacturing fault.

Several buyers also say retailers refused to swap or refund boxes that turned out to be empty or already used, GamingHQ reported. Rockstar has not announced a separate fix for affected retail copies. Its own pre-order support FAQ sends questions about copies bought elsewhere back to the retailer, while boxed orders from the Rockstar Store are handled by its payment partner, Xsolla .

title: GTA 6 Has Made $1.18 Billion Before Launch, and It Still May Not Save Console Sales
content:
Grand Theft Auto VI has not launched yet, but it is already one of the biggest entertainment releases of 2026. Sensor Tower estimates that the game had taken about 12.1 million digital pre-orders across PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S by the morning of 13 November, worth roughly $1.18 billion. Those figures come from the analytics firm’s public GTA VI sales tracker , and neither Rockstar nor Take-Two has confirmed a pre-order count. Take-Two has, however, said that demand is running well ahead of its own plans.

The game unlocks on 19 November, with the standard edition priced at $80 , and the launch times for every region are already set. Pre-loading opened on 10 November, according to Rockstar , and the PS5 download weighs 212GB . That download alone was enough to set a traffic record at Virgin Media in the UK. The size of the launch is now shaping what rival publishers, console makers and players do this month.

The pace of the run-up is what stands out. Sensor Tower’s tracker put pre-orders at about 7.71 million copies and $751 million on 3 November, then at 10.31 million copies and roughly $1 billion on 11 November. Two days later, the estimate had reached 12.1 million copies and $1.18 billion. In its recent breakdowns, PS5 accounted for about three quarters of all copies, with Xbox Series X|S taking the rest.

Take-Two’s own language has been just as bullish. Reporting second-quarter results on 9 November, the company said GTA VI pre-orders were “tracking far above our initial expectations”, while chief executive Strauss Zelnick said they were “continuing to reach unprecedented levels”. Take-Two kept its full-year net bookings forecast of $8.0 billion to $8.2 billion, and guided for $3.35 billion to $3.5 billion in the quarter that includes the launch, according to its earnings release . Net bookings in the second quarter itself fell 18% to $1.6 billion, which shows how much of the company’s year now rests on one game.

Fortune noted that $1.18 billion is already more than the roughly $1.01 billion that The Super Mario Galaxy Movie has grossed worldwide this year. Analysts have estimated that Take-Two spent between $1 billion and $1.5 billion developing GTA VI, so pre-orders are already in the same range as that budget. Sensor Tower’s figure is gross consumer spending before platform fees, however, so Take-Two’s own share of that money is smaller.

The bigger question is whether GTA VI can lift console sales the way earlier blockbusters did, and analysts quoted by Forbes are doubtful. US hardware spending fell 9% to $2.9 billion between January and September, according to Circana data cited in that report, and Xbox Series sales were down 27% year on year as of September. Louise Woolridge of Ampere Analysis said GTA VI will “definitely give console sales a boost, but I don’t think it will be enough to reverse the year-on-year decline”. Circana’s Mat Piscatella called it the “biggest video game launch of all time”, although he expects most new console buyers to come from wealthier households.

title: Rockstar Says GTA 6 Is the First GTA to Encourage Empathy, and a Criminal Profile Will Track Your Violence
content:
Grand Theft Auto VI will give players ways to show empathy for the first time in the series’ history, according to Rob Nelson, co-studio head at Rockstar North. “We’ve tried for the first time in a GTA to provide mechanisms that encourage it, for those who want to,” Nelson told The Guardian . The paper’s games editor, Keza MacDonald, visited the studio in Edinburgh ahead of the game’s 19 November launch. Asked directly whether GTA 6 encourages empathy, he tied it to the plot rather than to a rulebook. “I would say that it’s a product of the story we’re trying to tell,” he said.

That story belongs to Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, whom Nelson described as “a younger couple with their backs against the wall”. The systems are optional, and many of them are small. Jason can ask a passer-by for permission before petting their dog, for example, and people on the street react when the player interrupts their conversations. None of this replaces the series’ usual chaos, although it gives players who want a gentler run through Leonida something to work with, a shift that has been building since Rockstar’s first trailer and reveal .

The biggest of those mechanics is the relationship itself. When they are apart, Jason and Lucia call and text each other, and when they are together they can go on dates to the gym, a bar or a meditation retreat. A liquor store stick-up also counts as a date, and a dedicated button lets the pair hold hands. “The relationship is yours to nurture or yours to lose,” Nelson said, adding that whether it stays romantic is up to the player.

Neglecting the relationship has consequences, according to the preview, although Rockstar has not said how far they go. Players who have no interest in romance can ignore the system entirely. They can switch between Jason and Lucia for most of the game, while some story moments lock players into one character’s perspective for a stretch. Rockstar’s second trailer leaned heavily on the same partnership, and it remains the clearest official look at the pair together.

Jason and Lucia also start out as small-time criminals. Early on, they can only hotwire cheap cars and pick basic locks, and bigger jobs come later in the story. Before a robbery, players can scout the location, find a back door or a safe code, and disable security cameras or take their footage. In the demo Rockstar showed the press, a jewellery store robbery without that preparation ended with a guard opening fire and a police chase across half a district.

Crime, Nelson said, is still “a fundamental part of GTA”, although he added “at least up until now, it has been”. Rockstar is “trying to make sure we’re not punishing people for playing the game they are used to”, he said, while promising that “your actions will have some effect on how the game plays out”. Players can still cause traffic jams, shove pedestrians and flee the scene of an accident.

title: Steam Now Shows Real Average FPS for Thousands of Steam Deck Games, and Desktop PCs Are Next
content:
Steam store pages now show the average frame rate that players actually get in thousands of games on Steam Deck, and Valve has started asking desktop PC users to share the same data. “With today’s update, you can now see the average framerate players get in games on Steam Deck,” Valve said in its Steam Deck Framerate announcement , which went live late on 9 November. The figure sits in the Steam Deck Compatibility section of each store page, under “Learn more”, with a histogram behind it. Valve calls the Deck rollout “a stepping stone toward providing framerate data for more devices than just Steam Deck”, although it has given no date for desktop PCs.

The feature has been months in the making. TalkEsport reported in April that Steam was testing FPS estimates in its client beta , with Valve saying at the time that it would “focus on devices running SteamOS”. That beta is what now feeds the public numbers. Some posts circulating this weekend suggest Steam already estimates performance for any PC, but the store data so far covers Steam Deck only, and desktop collection is still at the opt-in stage.

The average is “calculated using data from customers who have opted in to providing framerate data,” Valve said. The setting sits under Steam’s account settings, in the Data and Browsing section, as Anonymous Game Framerate Data, and the Steam library prompts players to switch it on. The data comes from the same frame rate reporting tool Valve built for developers, who have been able to see similar figures for their own games in Steamworks for months. A game needs a minimum number of samples before its figure appears.

Valve also limits which players’ numbers count towards the average. Only Decks running the default frame limit contribute, which means 60fps on the LCD model and 90fps on the OLED model, and the data does not account for custom graphics settings or power limits. That sounds like a weakness, but once the effect of vertical sync is taken into account, Valve says it has “found that the framerate data consolidates around relatively narrow ranges”. Every Deck uses the same AMD chip design and a 1280×800 screen, so one game’s numbers from thousands of players can be compared directly.

The histogram matters more than the headline figure. An average of 45fps can hide a game that swings between 60fps in menus and 25fps in combat, while the distribution shows how much time is spent at each frame rate. Stutters and hitches appear as small columns at the low end of the chart. One limit remains, however: an average cannot show whether frames were rendered by the GPU or created by frame generation, and it is not yet clear how Valve treats generated frames.

Valve’s reason for publishing the data is a candid one. Its Deck Verified programme rates games against fixed criteria, and Valve says that testing “may not match every customer’s bar for acceptable gameplay”. A game can be Verified while running at 30fps, which some players accept and others do not. The new figures cover games rated Verified, Playable and Unsupported, so buyers can now see performance even where Valve’s badge says little.

title: Jonathan’s Team Apex Gaming Reportedly in Final Talks for a New BGMI Roster After CEGC 2026
content:
Team Apex Gaming (TAG), the organisation founded by Jonathan “Jonathan” Amaral, is in final discussions to sign a new Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) roster, according to a report shared by Indian esports insiders on 14 November. The Chennai Esports Global Championship (CEGC) 2026 is expected to be the current line-up’s last tournament, with an official announcement to follow once the event is over. TAG itself has not yet commented on the report. If it is confirmed, the change would come only days after one of the organisation’s founders said the current players were signed for a year.

That founder was Shreeman Legend, who dismissed rumours of a disbandment on his stream on 12 November. He said the line-up was “signed for one year” and that he had heard nothing directly suggesting a change. He also said TAG would play CEGC 2026 with the same players, which the new report does not dispute, since it places any change after the tournament. Neither TAG nor Shreeman has explained how a new signing would fit with the one-year deal he described.

A second report , citing sources, went further and named the players involved. It said TAG was in advanced talks with the line-up led by in-game leader (IGL) Omega, and that the discussions were going well, although Omega had yet to give his final confirmation. Offers had also gone to other line-ups, including Saumraj’s, while a new roster built around Punkk was described as a last-resort option. The same report said the exit of TAG’s current line-up, known as Team Jelly after its IGL, was confirmed for after CEGC 2026.

All three IGLs are playing at CEGC 2026 with their own teams. Omega captains Team Outrage, which finished first in Group Stage 1 with 278 points and went straight to the Upper Bracket. Omega’s main four at the event also includes slug, knightū and ninjaboi, so a deal for the whole line-up would bring in the Group Stage 1 leaders. Saumraj leads K9 Esports and Punkk captains VR1 Esports, and both teams finished outside the top eight. None of the three players or their teams has commented on the reports, and TalkEsport has not independently confirmed any of the talks.

TAG’s current roster is led by IGL Jellly, with Jonathan, Hydrooo and Harsh05 in the main four and KioLmao as a substitute, according to the rosters registered for CEGC 2026 . The team finished 15th in Group Stage 1 with 194 points, which sent it into Group Stage 2 instead of straight to the Upper Bracket. Group Stage 2 runs until 16 November, and only its top eight teams join the Upper Bracket, while the rest drop into the Lower Bracket. Partway through the second stage, TAG was sitting close to that top-eight line.

Either way, the current line-up’s run could last for weeks. The Lower Bracket is played on 21 and 22 November, followed by a Last Chance Qualifier from 27 to 29 November. The 16-team Grand Finals take place at a LAN in Chennai from 11 to 13 December. The tournament carries a ₹75 lakh prize pool. If TAG reaches the finals and the announcement waits for the end of the event, the new roster may not be confirmed until mid-December.

title: FURIA sweep Spirit to become the first repeat BLAST Rivals champions
content:
KSCERATO won clutch after clutch as FURIA took both of Spirit’s map picks and gave FalleN one more trophy before Singapore.

Ancient is Spirit’s best map. Over the last three months they had won 75% of their Ancient maps, against 42% for FURIA, and they picked it to open the Grand Final in Hong Kong. FURIA took it 13-11 from 11-9 down, and Spirit never got back into the series. FURIA beat Team Spirit 3-0 (Ancient 13-11, Dust2 13-5, Mirage 13-8) on Sunday to win BLAST Rivals 2026 Season 2 and keep the title they won in Hong Kong a year ago. No team had defended a Rivals title before.

It is FURIA’s third trophy in 28 days, after the Thunderpick World Championship and PGL Masters Bucharest, and three titles from their last four events, with a quarter-final exit at IEM Beijing in between. Spirit had won the last three series between the teams, the latest in Bucharest in October. FURIA take $250,000 and Spirit $200,000.

A #FURIACS É A GRANDE CAMPEÃ DA #BLASTPremier RIVALS HONG KONG 2026! 🏆 VAMOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO Ancient 13-11, Dust II 13-5, Mirage 13-8 A FURIA DE FINAL DE ANO É ISSO DAÍ MESMO!… pic.twitter.com/krU6eix2iA

Spirit had beaten MOUZ on Ancient in Saturday’s semi-final and were comfortable starting there. FURIA, by contrast, used to ban it. They changed their veto during the season, now throw out Anubis instead, and have rebuilt the map around new roles: Gabriel “FalleN” Toledo plays Cave, and Mareks “YEKINDAR” Gaļinskis does the calling.

For most of the map, Spirit’s plan worked. Danil “donk” Kryshkovets won the opening duels in mid again and again, went 15-6 in the first half and finished 27-15 with 125.1 ADR and 87.5% KAST, a four-kill round included. Spirit led 11-9 in the second half, two rounds from going 1-0 up.

title: HOTU Academy’s ayakasi passes donk’s FACEIT Elo record at 18
content:
A HOTU Academy player is now first on the FACEIT ladder, more than 200 Elo ahead of the Team Spirit star.

Level 10, the highest skill level on FACEIT, starts at 2,001 Elo. On Saturday night, an 18-year-old from HOTU’s academy side went more than 3,500 past it. Aleksandr “ayakasi” Kononov reached 5,528 Elo, which beats donk ‘s previous record of 5,513, according to NarT and Russian outlet Cybersport.Metaratings . FACEIT has not commented on the record itself, but his profile showed 5,528 Elo and first place in Europe on Sunday morning.

NarT posted the news shortly before midnight on Saturday.

🤯 ayakasi has just broken donk's all-time FACEIT ELO record! The 18 year old HOTU Academy player, who recently reached #1 on FACEIT, has now hit 5,528 ELO, surpassing donk's previous record of 5,513! https://t.co/svY1Oh8B7c pic.twitter.com/5hCZxAHgLk

ayakasi plays under the nickname taini- on FACEIT. He has played 551 matches in Season 9, and he took first place on the European ladder on 13 November, Cybersport.Metaratings reports.

The top of FACEIT has changed hands a few times in CS2, and the record has climbed each time.

title: League of Legends: New Dawn Revealed at Worlds 2026 With Major Overhaul Coming in 2027
content:
Riot Games has officially announced League of Legends: New Dawn, a major overhaul of its popular MOBA scheduled for release in 2027. Revealed during the League of Legends World Championship 2026 Grand Final on November 14, the update promises significant improvements to the game’s visuals, client, gameplay and overall player experience.

The announcement marks one of the most ambitious developments in League of Legends’ history. Rather than introducing a completely separate sequel, Riot intends to modernize the existing game while preserving its familiar competitive identity.

A full reveal is scheduled for January 2027, when players will learn more about the upcoming changes.

League of Legends originally launched in 2009 and has remained one of the most influential competitive multiplayer games for over 17 years.

Throughout that period, Riot Games has continuously introduced new champions, gameplay adjustments, visual improvements and seasonal updates.

However, New Dawn represents a significantly larger development than a traditional patch or preseason update.

title: BLAST Rivals Returns to Hong Kong in 2027 After Two Consecutive Sold-Out Events
content:
BLAST has confirmed that BLAST Premier Rivals will return to Hong Kong in November 2027, marking the third consecutive year that the city hosts the international Counter-Strike 2 tournament. The announcement follows another sold-out edition at AsiaWorld-Arena, reinforcing Hong Kong’s growing importance as a destination for major esports competitions.

The tournament organizer has not yet announced the exact dates or ticket prices for 2027. Additional information is expected in the coming months, while preparations for the next edition are already underway.

The confirmation comes during BLAST Premier Rivals Fall 2026, which takes place from November 11 to 15.

The tournament features eight international CS2 teams competing for a total of $1 million in prize money and team payments.

Following the success of the first two editions, BLAST intends to continue developing its presence in the Asian esports market.

James Woollard, BLAST’s Vice President of Destinations and Market Development, expressed enthusiasm about the decision to return.

title: FURIA’s yuurih Thanks Falcons for Fair Play After Controversial Technical Issue at BLAST Rivals 2026
content:
FURIA secured a 2-0 victory against Team Falcons in the BLAST Rivals Fall 2026 semifinals on November 14, but the match attracted attention for more than its result. A technical issue involving Mareks “YEKINDAR” Gaļinskis created a controversial situation on Dust2, prompting Falcons to support a round replay.

Following the series, FURIA player Yuri “yuurih” praised his opponents for their sportsmanship. In an interview with HLTV, the Brazilian explained how the decision helped prevent a technical malfunction from influencing an important moment in the match.

The incident occurred during Dust2, the second map of the semifinal.

FURIA had already secured an early five-versus-four advantage against Falcons, who were playing an eco round. However, YEKINDAR unexpectedly disconnected because of a technical problem.

Despite FURIA’s initial advantage, Falcons managed to win the affected round.

Rather than simply accepting the result, Falcons requested that the round be replayed, demonstrating a willingness to prioritize competitive fairness.

title: BLG Players and Coach Daeny Reflect on Worlds 2026 Triumph After Historic Final
content:
Bilibili Gaming (BLG) have officially claimed the League of Legends World Championship 2026 title after defeating Gen.G 3-1 in the Grand Final on November 14. Following their historic victory, players Bin, Xun, Knight, Viper and ON, alongside head coach Daeny, reflected on their challenging journey, previous disappointments and the importance of bringing the Summoner’s Cup back to China.

The championship marks BLG’s first Worlds title and ends a five-year drought for the LPL, which last celebrated a World Championship victory through EDward Gaming in 2021.

For BLG midlaner Knight, winning Worlds 2026 represents the achievement of a lifelong competitive ambition.

After years of domestic success and international disappointments, the Chinese star finally secured the trophy that had remained out of reach throughout his career.

Knight emphasized that winning the World Championship had always been his ultimate objective. He also highlighted the significance of overcoming BLG’s painful defeat against T1 in the 2024 final.

His performance against Gen.G earned him the Finals MVP award, adding another individual achievement to an already decorated career.

title: FalleN: “Your soul is not there […] it’s just the body”
content:
FURIA’s retiring captain says he lost his energy and passion for months this year, and only found his drive again recently.

FalleN has opened up about the hardest part of his final season. Speaking on BLAST’s broadcast after FURIA beat Falcons 2-0 in the semi-final of BLAST Rivals 2026 Season 2 on Saturday, the 2016 Major winner said there were months when he was only there in body.

Asked what it would mean to win the Major in Singapore as his last event, he described a year spent “fighting against myself for many months”:

We had some situations in the team, like we are not fully connected on the beginning of the year, we fixed all those things, at some point, at some point, I didn’t really have the energy or the passion to really give my best every day, even though I was still there, you know, when sometimes you are in the situation, sometimes you are in a place, but your soul is not there, you know, it’s just the body.

That has changed. “I think I was able to find that drive to finish better,” FalleN said, calling it “remarkable” to still be competing 23 years after he started and ten years after the top of 2016. A Major title would be “a cherry on top”.

FalleN, who retires at the end of the year, spent most of the answer on his teammates rather than on the trophy.

title: zonic “never, ever should have left Vitality”, Pimp argues
content:
The analyst called the coach’s 2023 move to Falcons one of the biggest coaching mistakes Counter-Strike has seen, in a podcast released on the day Falcons lost their Hong Kong semi-final.

Jacob “Pimp” Winneche said on the Last Free Nation podcast, in an episode released on Saturday 14 November, that Danny “zonic” Sørensen should have stayed with Team Vitality instead of joining Team Falcons in 2023. The same day, Falcons lost 2-0 to FURIA in the semi-finals of BLAST Rivals in Hong Kong, a day after Vitality went out in the quarter-finals .

Pimp, who played under zonic at Team Dignitas in 2015, used his turn in the show’s hot take segment for it.

I think one of the biggest mistakes that’s ever been made in history of Counter-Strike from a coaching perspective was from zonic to say yes to go to Falcons. I think he never, ever should have gone to Falcons. He never, ever should have left Vitality.

He stressed that it was no criticism of Rémy “XTQZZZ” Quoniam, zonic’s successor at Vitality, whom he rates as a great coach. His point was that zonic would also have won plenty with that team. Pimp described the Dane as a methodical coach who builds a system in which every player has a job, and Falcons as a project built on buying stars. In his words, zonic has been “a mismatch for Falcons pretty much throughout the entirety of the time”. Pimp also said Vitality were talking to zonic about a new contract when he chose to leave.

The record since the move supports the first half of the argument. zonic left Vitality on 11 October 2023, less than five months after winning the Paris Major with them, and joined Falcons on 1 November. XTQZZZ returned to Vitality two days after zonic’s exit.

title: OTP débarque sur VALORANT
content:
OTP élargit ses horizons ! Connue pour sa couverture de League of Legends et ses retransmissions des plus grandes compétitions internationales, la chaîne française a profité d’un rendez-vous particulièrement suivi pour annoncer une grande nouveauté. Ce samedi, en plein direct de la finale des Worlds 2026 entre Gen.G et Bilibili Gaming, le crew a officialisé son arrivée sur VALORANT, le FPS tactique de Riot Games.

Une annonce accompagnée d’un premier teaser et de la présentation d’un nouveau compte dédié, @OTP_Valorant, sur les réseaux sociaux. Pour l’instant, la chaîne entretient volontairement le mystère autour de ce projet. Aucun détail supplémentaire n’a été communiqué concernant les programmes, les intervenants ou les compétitions qui pourraient être couverts. Les fans devront patienter jusqu’au 24 novembre à partir de 19h pour en apprendre davantage.

Avec cette arrivée sur VALORANT, OTP s’apprête à franchir une nouvelle étape dans son développement. Après s’être imposée comme une référence francophone sur League of Legends, la chaîne entend désormais s’ouvrir à une autre communauté particulièrement active de l’esport. Un choix qui pourrait lui permettre de toucher un nouveau public, tout en conservant son identité et son approche de la compétition.

Reste désormais à découvrir ce que réserve exactement OTP aux amateurs du FPS de Riot Games. Retransmissions, émissions, analyses ou nouveaux visages : plusieurs possibilités peuvent être envisagées, mais rien n’a encore été confirmé. Une chose est sûre, le rendez-vous est donné au 24 novembre, date à laquelle les premières informations sur cette nouvelle aventure devraient être dévoilées.

OTP DÉBARQUE SUR VALORANT ! Souhaitez la bienvenue à @OTP_Valorant pic.twitter.com/Y53KZzH6C6

title: karrigan answers BLAST’s retirement jab with one word
content:
The organiser put Falcons’ captain next to the retiring FalleN during the Hong Kong semi-final and asked fans to choose.

karrigan has replied with a single “Ok” to a post from BLAST that asked fans which of him and FalleN is retiring. The organiser posted it on Saturday at 12:51 CET , while FURIA were on their way to a 2-0 win over Falcons in the semi-final of BLAST Rivals 2026 Season 2 in Hong Kong.

Which one is retiring? YOU DECIDE 🫵 #BLASTPremier pic.twitter.com/pO79qwh99R

FalleN has said he will retire at the end of the year, and BLAST had already joked about it on Thursday. The 36-year-old Dane answered on Saturday evening.

BLAST’s post had been viewed more than 670,000 times by Sunday morning. On Reddit, a thread about it passed 1,000 upvotes, and the community was split. Some called it harmless banter. Others argued that a tournament organiser, which is meant to be neutral, should not mock one player’s performance in the middle of a match.

It came on a hard day for karrigan. He finished the semi-final 19-36 with 45.4 ADR, including 9-23 on Falcons’ own Ancient pick. On Dust2, the crowd booed him after a round was replayed from 4-2, a round in which he had picked up a USP kill after YEKINDAR dropped out of the server. Both teams had agreed to the reset, as we wrote in our report from the semi-final .

title: LOUD part ways with Darker a month after their Champions title
content:
The Colombian controller is the second member of LOUD’s Champions-winning lineup to leave, after tkzin.

LOUD have announced the departure of Sebastián “Darker” Castro Cicuamia, less than a month after the controller helped them win Valorant Champions Shanghai. The Brazilian club said goodbye in a video on X on Friday 13 November.

“Today our paths diverge, but we take pride in everything we built together. See you on the server, Darker. Thank you for everything!” LOUD wrote in Portuguese.

Hoje nos despedimos do @Loud_darkerVL Darker chegou à LOUD com vontade de conquistar seu espaço e mostrou, dia após dia, até onde sua dedicação poderia levá-lo. Mais do que acompanhar sua evolução como jogador, tivemos o privilégio de vê-lo fazer parte de uma conquista que… pic.twitter.com/2bZ8il9iGL

Darker is the second of the five Champions winners to go. LOUD posted a farewell to Enzo “tkzin” Zimiani on 5 November, although Sheep Esports later reported that the duelist had agreed to stay. VLR.gg wrote on Sunday that erde and lukxo are rumoured to be joining another team in the Americas.

LOUD signed Darker from E-Xolos LAZER in December 2025, where he had won four straight titles in Challengers LATAM North across 2024 and 2025. The move reunited him with his former E-Xolos teammate Virtyy.

title: Worlds 2026 : BLG renverse l’empire Gen.G, la Chine retrouve sa couronne !
content:
La Chine tient enfin son nouveau champion du monde ! Ce samedi soir, devant le public du Barclays Center de Brooklyn, Bilibili Gaming a remporté les Worlds 2026 de League of Legends en dominant Gen.G (3-1). Une performance majuscule face à une formation coréenne qui semblait pourtant intouchable depuis le début de la compétition. Avec dix victoires pour une seule défaite avant cette finale, Chovy et ses coéquipiers avaient notamment survolé la phase suisse et les playoffs, éliminant successivement LYON et Invictus Gaming sur le score de 3-0.

Et les champions de LCK ont d’abord parfaitement assumé leur statut. Malgré une draft laissant le redoutable duo Kalista-Renata à BLG, Gen.G a pris les commandes de la première manche grâce à un Ruler impérial sur Corki (7/0/8). Après 38 minutes de jeu, c’est justement l’Empereur qui a conclu la rencontre sur un triple kill. Mais Bilibili Gaming n’avait pas dit son dernier mot. Portés par un XUN exceptionnel sur Naafiri (8/1/9) et un Knight omniprésent, les Chinois ont égalisé au terme d’une deuxième partie complètement folle. Malgré les efforts de Ruler sur Ezreal et de Canyon sur Cho’Gath, BLG a fini par s’imposer après 53 minutes, la partie la plus longue de ces Worlds. Viper a notamment établi un record du tournoi avec près de 95 000 dégâts infligés sur Ziggs.

CANYON STEAL L'ELDER SEUL FHDHDHDH pic.twitter.com/cKlUdALHVG

La troisième manche a confirmé le changement de dynamique. Dans une rencontre encore extrêmement disputée, Bilibili Gaming a profité d’une rare erreur de Ruler pour prendre l’ascendant en milieu de partie. Les Chinois ont ensuite multiplié les teamfights victorieux, avec un Viper étincelant sur Taliyah (6/1/11). Une nouvelle démonstration de sa maîtrise des mages sur la botlane, qui a permis à BLG de conclure en 37 minutes et de s’offrir deux balles de match. Gen.G, pourtant annoncé comme le grand favori de cette finale, se retrouvait désormais dos au mur.

ENCORE UNE GAME BANGER ! QUELLE FINALE pic.twitter.com/Dru8bjBukG

Et malgré un début de quatrième manche impressionnant de Ruler sur Xayah, le champion avec lequel il avait remporté les Worlds 2017, BLG a encore trouvé les ressources pour faire la différence. Le duo Nocturne-Twisted Fate a semé le chaos dans les rangs coréens, tandis que Bin a multiplié les flanks dévastateurs avec sa Gwen (8/2/9). De son côté, ON a trouvé plusieurs Pop Blossom décisifs sur Neeko. Gen.G a bien tenté un dernier retour, remportant un teamfight crucial pour récupérer l’âme du dragon techno-chimique autour de la 40e minute. Mais les Chinois ont immédiatement répondu en sécurisant le Nashor, avant de foncer sur la midlane en supériorité numérique pour détruire le Nexus adverse. Cette fois, même l’Empereur Ruler n’a rien pu faire.

title: Fortnite Treasure Hour explained: Pirate Token odds and more
content:
The Fortnite Treasure Hour events give you the best chance to find the elusive Pirate Shop Token, which grants you 14 days of free Item Shop cosmetics. One week has already passed, and only a few Treasure Hours remain before the season ends.

Here is everything you need to know, including the increased odds of finding the rare Pirate Shop Token or the weekly Gold Outfit.

Epic Games previously released the full odds of finding the various Treasures available this season. The Weekly Gold Outfit, previously A$AP Rocky and now Lil’ Uzi Vert , has by far the highest odds at over 1 in 1.5 million.

However, the Pirate Shop Access Token has snatched most of the headlines, despite the lower odds. Players of all skill levels have spent thousands of hours searching Chests in hopes of finding it.

That’s where the Fortnite Treasure Hour events come into play, since they cut those odds significantly, from 1 in 137,500 to as low as 1 in 68,750. It’s worth taking advantage of these two-hour time windows to increase your chances.

title: League of Legends: New Dawn – New Summoner’s Rift, Client, and more
content:
League Next, the long-awaited update to Riot’s flagship MOBA, now has an official name: League of Legends: New Dawn . It will bring a new (likely integrated) client, an overhaul to Summoner’s Rift, updated champion visuals and gameplay, and more. Here’s everything we know about the New Dawn update.

Riot hasn’t publicly announced when the massive update is going live. However, we do know that it won’t be the first Season of 2027 .

This leaves Seasons Two and Three, which places League of Legends: New Dawn’s release date anywhere between April and August 2027 . This section will be updated once Riot reveals more information about New Dawn’s release date.

League of Legends: New Dawn, previously known as “League Next,” is a massive overhaul to the client and game. It was revealed during the Grand Final of Worlds 2026 , and we expect it to release sometime around mid-2027.

Preliminary information sent by Riot Games to esports.gg tells us that New Dawn will be an overhaul of League as a product.

We are finally getting a new client after a decade. The last time the client got an update this big was in 2017.

title: League of Legends : Riot Games dévoile New Dawn, sa grande révolution pour 2027
content:
Riot Games a profité de la grande finale des Worlds 2026 entre Gen.G et Bilibili Gaming, organisée au Barclays Center de Brooklyn, pour lever le voile sur l’avenir de League of Legends. Baptisée « New Dawn », cette refonte d’envergure promet de moderniser plusieurs aspects du jeu dès 2027. Comme le rapporte Sheep Esports , le projet comprend notamment un tout nouveau client, une Faille de l’invocateur retravaillée et des évolutions du gameplay. De quoi donner un sérieux coup de jeune au MOBA, lancé en 2009 et toujours incontournable sur la scène compétitive.

Les premières images dévoilées par Riot Games permettent déjà d’entrevoir l’ampleur des changements. La Faille de l’invocateur bénéficiera d’une nouvelle direction visuelle, avec des environnements plus détaillés, des zones de jungle revisitées et de nouvelles créatures. Les sbires auront également droit à une refonte graphique, tandis que l’interface du client et l’écran de sélection des champions seront modernisés. Riot promet aussi de nouvelles façons de profiter de ses champions préférés, sans toutefois préciser pour l’instant ce que cela impliquera concrètement.

Si ce premier aperçu a de quoi susciter la curiosité des joueurs, de nombreuses questions restent encore sans réponse. Riot Games n’a notamment pas détaillé les modifications de gameplay qui accompagneront New Dawn, ni communiqué de date de sortie précise. L’éditeur n’a pas non plus indiqué comment cette transformation pourrait affecter la scène professionnelle, alors que la saison compétitive 2027 débutera dès janvier avec les premiers splits régionaux. Une présentation plus complète du projet est toutefois annoncée pour janvier prochain.

Pour accompagner cette annonce, Riot Games a également dévoilé un premier teaser d’une nouvelle cinématique mettant en scène plusieurs champions emblématiques de League of Legends. Blitzcrank, Lux, Leona, Sett, Tristana, Volibear, Ashe, Jhin ou encore Ahri figurent notamment parmi les personnages aperçus. La date de sortie de cette cinématique reste inconnue. À l’approche du vingtième anniversaire du jeu, prévu en 2029, New Dawn pourrait bien marquer le début d’une nouvelle ère pour League of Legends.

A peek at where we’re headed for 2027 pic.twitter.com/Wqem6t48pn

title: Zest débarque en LEC chez NAVI
content:
Natus Vincere tient son nouveau toplaner. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Kim « Zest » Dong-min aurait trouvé un accord verbal avec la structure ukrainienne pour la saison 2027 du LEC. Le Sud-Coréen de 23 ans devrait ainsi quitter LØS après une année particulièrement réussie au Brésil. Également courtisé par FlyQuest en Amérique du Nord, il aurait finalement choisi de tenter sa chance en Europe. Son contrat arrivant à expiration en novembre, NAVI pourrait récupérer le joueur sans avoir à payer d’indemnité de transfert.

Arrivé chez LØS en janvier 2026, Zest s’est rapidement imposé comme l’un des éléments importants de l’équipe. Après une finale perdue face à FURIA lors du premier split du CBLOL, la formation brésilienne a pris sa revanche lors du second (3-2), décrochant son billet pour les Worlds. Sur la scène internationale, LØS a ensuite signé le meilleur parcours de l’histoire du Brésil, éliminant notamment Secret Whales et Team Liquid avant de s’incliner face à LYON (1-2) lors de l’ultime tour de la phase suisse. Un parcours remarquable qui a permis à Zest de se faire remarquer au-delà de sa région.

L’arrivée attendue de Zest représente une belle avancée pour Natus Vincere, dont le mercato avait jusque-là été marqué par plusieurs échecs. La structure ukrainienne aurait notamment tenté de recruter BrokenBlade et Myrwn sur la toplane, mais les deux joueurs auraient respectivement privilégié Movistar KOI et GIANTX. Zest devrait finalement prendre la succession de Maynter, dont le contrat arrive à expiration, et apporter son expérience internationale à un effectif largement remanié.

Avec ce recrutement, NAVI aurait désormais trouvé quatre de ses cinq titulaires pour la prochaine saison. Rhilech, élu rookie de l’année 2026 en LEC, devrait rester au cœur du projet, tandis que Supa est attendu au poste d’AD Carry après trois saisons chez KOI. Parus devrait également conserver sa place au poste de support, sous les ordres de TheRock, maintenu comme head coach. Il ne manquerait donc plus qu’un midlaner pour compléter cette nouvelle formation, qui espère franchir un cap en 2027 après une première année dans l’élite européenne.

title: ZGOD Leaves GodLike Esports, Says He Was “Going Through a Lot”
content:
In a surprising turn of events, Abhishek “ZGOD” Choudhary has bid farewell to GodLike Esports after being a part of the organization for several years. He announced the departure via an Instagram story on 14 November, where he wrote “Left GodLike!” He did not say when the split took effect, whether it was his decision, or the exact reason behind it. Furthermore, GodLike has not commented on his departure.

In the same Instagram Story, ZGOD acknowledged he had been “inactive lately” and said he “was going through a lot”. He added that he had “a lot to unpack” and would speak about it soon on stream.

ZGOD joined GodLike Esports as a part of the team when the organization signed TSMEntity’s former Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) roster. He competed as a player of GodLike Esports BGMI roster for four years, from August 2021 to August 2025.

During his tenure with GodLike Esports, the team showcased strong performance, winning Skyesports Championship 3.0, securing 4th position at Battlegrounds Mobile India Series 2021 (BGIS 2021), representing India at PUBG Mobile Global Championship 2021, securing the runner-up position in BGMI Masters Series Season 1, and more.

After 2021, the team failed to win an A-Tier tournament. As a result, in August 2025, the organization decided to rebuild its roster, and ZGOD was among the players released. Following his departure, he joined 4TR as a BGMI esports player but stayed with GodLike Esports as a content creator. Notably, he hasn’t played competitive BGMI since March 2026.

Since leaving GodLike Esports’ BGMI roster, ZGOD was seen actively creating content for GodLike Esports, including collabs with other creators from the organization. From the outside, the partnership looked stable. His recent quiet spell was the only hint that something might be off. For now, the details will have to wait for his stream or GodLike Esports’ statement.

title: League of Legends Worlds 2026 Grand Final: Date, Time, and Where to Watch
content:
The 2026 League of Legends World Championship is nearing its end, and after a month of intense matches across three US cities, only two teams remain in the battle for the prestigious trophy.

The two remaining teams, Gen.G and Bilibili Gaming, will meet in the grand final of LoL Worlds 2026 at Brooklyn’s Barclays Center.

Gen.G secured their grand final spot by taking down Invictus Gaming in a 3-0 sweep, while Bilibili Gaming beat T1 3-1 in the semis, ending T1’s run of four consecutive Worlds finals.

The two remaining teams will now clash in the grand final of the event, with the winner taking home a whopping $1 million USD from the $5 million USD prize pool alongside the title of world champion. The runners-up will receive $800,000 USD instead.

title: Jopa de retour chez Vitality… cette fois en LEC
content:
C’est un retour aux sources qui se prépare du côté de Team Vitality. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Josip « Jopa » Čančar aurait trouvé un accord verbal avec la structure française pour la saison 2027 du LEC. L’AD Carry croate était la priorité de Vitality à ce poste, devant plusieurs autres pistes comme Aetinoth, Supa, Carzzy ou encore HARPOON. Après avoir initialement mis l’offre en attente pour explorer d’autres possibilités, notamment auprès de Movistar KOI et GIANTX, le joueur aurait finalement décidé de retrouver son ancienne organisation.

Un choix qui possède une dimension particulière pour Jopa, déjà passé par Vitality.Bee en 2024 et 2025. À l’époque, le Croate évoluait dans l’équipe académique de la Ruche en LFL, sans parvenir à décrocher une place dans l’effectif principal. Vitality avait finalement préféré conserver Carzzy pour la saison 2026, poussant Jopa à tenter sa chance chez SK Gaming. Un pari réussi puisque, malgré les difficultés collectives de son équipe, le jeune AD Carry s’est distingué par ses performances individuelles, terminant notamment deuxième du classement des rookies de l’année en LEC, derrière Rhilech.

Avec ce retour attendu, Team Vitality tiendrait enfin sa première recrue pour 2027. La structure française prépare une reconstruction importante après une nouvelle saison décevante, avec notamment l’arrivée annoncée d’un nouveau staff composé de Reha et Wadi. Le recrutement de Jopa constituerait ainsi une première étape encourageante, alors que plusieurs autres dossiers restent encore en suspens. Les discussions autour de Naak Nako et de SkewMond, notamment, n’auraient toujours pas abouti.

Le chantier reste immense pour la Ruche, qui s’apprête à renouveler une grande partie de son effectif. Lyncas devrait rejoindre G2 Esports, tandis que Carzzy serait attendu chez Movistar KOI. De leur côté, FIESTA et Fleshy arrivent en fin de contrat, laissant de nombreuses interrogations sur la composition de l’équipe. Dans ce contexte, Jopa pourrait devenir l’un des premiers visages du nouveau projet Vitality. Après avoir dû quitter la structure pour découvrir le LEC, le Croate aurait désormais l’occasion de revenir par la grande porte et de s’imposer durablement sous les couleurs de la Ruche.

title: The Game Awards 2026 to Stream on Roblox for the First Time in History
content:
2026 is gonna be an exciting year for The Game Awards , as it marks the first time that the highly anticipated award ceremony is coming to Roblox.

In a recent announcement on X, The Game Awards confirmed that this year’s edition will be the first in the show’s history to stream live on Roblox. Players aged 18 and older will be able to watch it on the platform alongside friends and other viewers.

On December 10th, #TheGameAwards makes history as the show will stream live in @Roblox for the first time. Fans 18+ will be able to watch, vote and interact LIVE alongside gaming's biggest night. More details coming soon. pic.twitter.com/ouVtxXt7yV

For the unaware, The Game Awards 2026 is all set to take place on Thursday, December 10 , at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. The show’s opening act begins at 4:30 pm Pacific on December 10, which equates to 12:30 am GMT on December 11.

If you’re tuning in from inside Roblox, you’ll be able to catch the broadcast live through The Block , Roblox’s primary venue for hosting virtual events. This also marks the first time an awards show has been livestreamed on the platform.

Players on Roblox will not only be able to watch The Game Awards 2026, but they’ll also be able to vote and interact with the show while it airs, earning themselves some virtual merchandise along the way. Voting on the official categories will also be available for Roblox players as we get closer to the event dates.

title: R6 Osaka Major 2026 Playoffs Set Up FaZe vs DarkZero Grand Final
content:
The BLAST R6 Osaka Major 2026 has reached its final stage, with FaZe Clan and DarkZero emerging from a packed playoff bracket to fight for the title on November 15.

Eight teams entered the single-elimination playoffs at ATC Hall in Osaka, but only two remain. DarkZero defeated Team Liquid and Virtus.pro on their route to the final, while FaZe survived G2 Esports before sweeping Team Falcons in the semifinals.

The Grand Final will determine the final Major champion of the 2026 Rainbow Six Siege season.

The playoff field featured representatives from Europe, North America and South America after the Swiss Stage reduced the tournament from 16 teams to eight.

Every match was elimination, leaving no lower bracket or second chance.

That single-elimination format made every map especially important, and three of the four playoff series involving FaZe or DarkZero required major momentum swings.

title: FaZe Sweep Falcons to Reach BLAST R6 Major Osaka Final
content:
FaZe Clan are one series away from another major Rainbow Six Siege trophy after defeating Team Falcons 2-0 in the semifinals of the BLAST R6 Major Osaka 2026.

The Brazilian lineup of Cyber, soulz1, KDS, Handyy and vitaking produced a clean response to their earlier defeat against Falcons and secured a place in Sunday’s Grand Final against DarkZero.

For Falcons, the result ends an impressive tournament run one step before the title match.

The semifinal carried an obvious revenge storyline.

Falcons had already beaten FaZe 2-0 during the Swiss Stage on November 9. That result completed a perfect 3-0 Swiss run for the European-MENA roster and appeared to establish Falcons as one of the strongest teams in Osaka.

Five days later, FaZe reversed the scoreline completely.

title: Spirit Sweep MOUZ to Reach BLAST Rivals Fall 2026 Grand Final
content:
Team Spirit are through to the Grand Final of BLAST Rivals Fall 2026 after defeating MOUZ 2-0 in the first semifinal in Hong Kong.

Spirit controlled Mirage 13-7 before surviving a much closer Ancient 13-11, becoming the first team to secure a place in the title match.

The result also ends MOUZ’s run at the event after they had reached the semifinals with a 2-0 quarterfinal win over Vitality.

The series opened on Mirage, MOUZ’s map pick.

That advantage did not translate into early control.

Spirit immediately established the stronger rhythm and built a 9-3 lead before halftime. Their defensive structure repeatedly denied MOUZ the space required to build stable rounds, giving Spirit a large cushion before the side switch.

title: Worlds 2027 Heads to Japan and Korea as Riot Expands Global Calendar
content:
Riot Games has revealed the first major details for the 2027 League of Legends international calendar, confirming new host regions for Worlds, MSI and First Stand.

Worlds 2027 will be split between Japan and South Korea, with Japan hosting part of the World Championship for the first time. MSI will move to Valencia, Spain, while an expanded First Stand: All In will take place in China.

The announcements were made on November 13 as part of Riot’s wider look at the future of LoL Esports.

The biggest announcement concerns the World Championship.

Nagoya, Japan, will host the Swiss Stage of Worlds 2027. It will mark the first time Japan has hosted part of the League of Legends World Championship.

The tournament will then move to South Korea for the entire knockout phase.

title: BLAST Rivals 2026 Season 2 Semifinals Recap: FURIA to Face Spirit in Grand Final
content:
Gracing us with back-to-back matches, the semi-finals of the BLAST Rivals Season 2 2026 have reached the Grand Final. FURIA and Spirit secured dominant 2-0 victories against Falcons and MOUZ, respectively, giving us a highly exciting Grand Final clash to look forward to, and here is how it happened.

. @TEAM__SPIRIT ARE YOUR FIRST GRAND FINALISTS! #BLASTPremier #MMarkEvents pic.twitter.com/ArDe8EQzr1

Despite their drop in form coming into the tournament, Spirit started strong with 9 rounds on the defence on MOUZ’s pick of Mirage. Having won only 3 rounds before switching sides, MOUZ went into their defence with 3 rounds to their name. Despite winning the pistol, Spirit dropped the ball, giving the momentum back to MOUZ, who managed to cut down on the lead but failed to keep their streak going. Winning 3 rounds in a row, Spirit managed to push the game over the line, taking an early lead in the series.

A 3-0 start to the second map saw MOUZ take the early lead on their CT side, only for Spirit to overtake them with 4 rounds of their own. As MOUZ managed a single round, Spirit closed the first half with 4 in a row as they took the lead with an 8-4 lead. MOUZ managed to stun Spirit early on after switching sides with a 7-round streak, giving them the lead for the second time in the series. As the MOUZ offence kept building momentum, it came crashing down when Spirit secured their first round on their CT side. Hitting the board on the defence, they managed to secure a 5-round streak to close the series with a 13-11 win.

. @FURIA ARE HEADING TO THE GRAND FINAL! #BLASTPremier #MMarkEvents pic.twitter.com/sAfd2VuQc0

Falcons’ solid start fell apart in no time as FURIA’s defence started racking up rounds. Despite losing the pistol, FURIA converted the gun rounds later in the series to close out the first half with a narrow 7-5 lead. Having lost momentum, Falcons played catch-up for the entirety of the second half only to win the final two rounds of regulation to take the game to OT. Losing the first round, the Falcons had little room left as FURIA closed the opening map with two successful retakes on the CT side and took the lead in the series.

title: Only Fnatic, NIP and NAVI remain from CS:GO’s first Major
content:
Thirteen years after DreamHack Winter 2013, three of the 16 organisations are still in Counter-Strike, and one of the others closed for good in September.

Sixteen teams travelled to Jönköping for DreamHack Winter 2013, the first Valve-sponsored CS:GO Major, from 28 to 30 November 2013. Fnatic beat Ninjas in Pyjamas 2-1 in the final of the $250,000 event and became the first CS:GO Major winners . Thirteen years on, Fnatic, NIP and NAVI are the only organisations from that field with a team in Valve’s latest Regional Standings, published on 2 November.

NAVI, now the highest ranked of the three, lost both of their group matches in Jönköping and went home in the bottom four.

A fourth name is back on a server too. Copenhagen Wolves, who reached the quarter-finals with dupreeh, Xyp9x and device, returned to CS with a new roster on 28 September. The original Danish club closed in 2016, though, and the current team belongs to an American owner who revived the brand in 2023.

Complexity, semi-finalists in 2013, will not be joining them. They left CS2 in August 2025, and founder Jason Lake confirmed on 23 September that the organisation had ceased operations after 23 years, Strafe reported.

Thank you for 23 years of Complexity. pic.twitter.com/nDdC0w5wkv

title: LEC : le roster GIANTX au complet avec Harpoon
content:
Le mercato touche à sa fin du côté de GIANTX. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Franciszek « Harpoon » Gryszkiewicz aurait trouvé un accord verbal avec la structure espagnole pour la saison 2027 du LEC. À seulement 21 ans, l’AD Carry polonais s’apprête à découvrir l’élite européenne après avoir brillé sur la scène française avec Galions. Il retrouverait notamment Francisco « Thayger » Mazo Sánchez, son ancien coéquipier, lui aussi attendu chez GIANTX pour la prochaine saison.

La concurrence était pourtant importante pour décrocher cette dernière place. GIANTX aurait également étudié les profils de Jopa, Carzzy, Aetinoth et Supa avant de privilégier Harpoon. Plusieurs de ces joueurs ont depuis trouvé d’autres destinations : Jopa devrait rejoindre Vitality, Carzzy serait attendu chez KOI, tandis que Supa aurait choisi NAVI. Pour Harpoon, ce transfert représenterait une belle récompense après une année 2026 particulièrement réussie.

Sous les couleurs de Galions, Harpoon a réalisé une saison remarquable, marquée notamment par deux sacres consécutifs aux EMEA Masters. Après une finale du LFL Invitational perdue face à Solary, la formation française a pris sa revanche au printemps en dominant cette même équipe (3-0) en finale des EMEA Masters. Galions a ensuite remporté le Summer Split de la LFL face à TLN Pirates (3-1), avant de décrocher un nouveau titre européen. Des performances qui ont permis au Polonais de s’imposer parmi les AD Carries les plus prometteurs des ligues régionales.

Avec son ancien jungler Thayger, Harpoon devrait donc franchir un nouveau cap en 2027. Dans un entretien accordé à Sheep Esports , le joueur affichait déjà sa confiance quant à ses chances de réussir dans l’élite : « Je peux vraiment rivaliser en LEC et ne pas être simplement un rookie qui se fait écarter après une saison. » Un défi qu’il pourrait désormais relever au sein d’une équipe ambitieuse, qui mise largement sur les talents révélés dans les championnats régionaux.

Avec cette dernière arrivée attendue, GIANTX aurait désormais trouvé ses cinq titulaires pour la prochaine saison. Myrwn devrait prendre place sur la toplane après trois années chez Movistar KOI, tandis que Thayger retrouverait la jungle du LEC. Sur la midlane, le Sud-Coréen Feisty serait de retour après son passage chez LØS au Brésil. Enfin, Piero, ancien support de Solary et de la Karmine Corp Blue, devrait accompagner Harpoon sur la botlane. Le tout sous les ordres de Guilhoto, attendu pour une nouvelle saison au poste de head coach.

Après une année 2026 encourageante, mais sans véritable exploit, GIANTX espère franchir un cap avec cet effectif largement remanié. La structure espagnole a atteint les playoffs de chaque split cette saison, sans jamais parvenir en finale, avec une quatrième place comme meilleur résultat au printemps. En réunissant plusieurs joueurs expérimentés et des talents prometteurs issus des ERL, elle ambitionne désormais de se rapprocher du podium européen et de décrocher une qualification internationale. Reste à voir si cette nouvelle formule permettra à GIANTX de rivaliser avec les cadors du LEC.

Rocket League players can now display their MMR if they wish to do so. Enabling this option shows their MMR in competitive playlists and the scoreboard after a ranked match.

title: Call of Duty Ranked Levels: Every Skill Division and What Carries Into a New Title
content:
Call of Duty ranked levels in mainline multiplayer Ranked Play run from Bronze to a Top 250 leaderboard finish. Black Ops 7 treats a new season differently depending on whether you finished below Platinum, and a new title begins its own progression. Warzone and Call of Duty Mobile have separate ranked systems.

Black Ops 7 Ranked Play has seven named Skill Divisions that group players by rank, followed by Top 250, a place on the leaderboard for the highest-ranked competitors. In order, the eight ladder positions are Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Crimson, Iridescent, and Top 250. Top 250 is a leaderboard position rather than another ordinary division to grind through. As a new player, you’ll receive a starting rank only after winning the required placement matches.

This is the Black Ops 7 multiplayer ladder; Warzone and Call of Duty Mobile use their own ranked systems.

Players in the Bronze division through Gold keep their rank and SR when a new season starts, but players in Platinum and above need a placement win. Rank is only part of what a profile carries, though: building one from scratch with the level, weapons, and camos you want takes a long run of matches. Players who would rather start from a finished profile can browse Call of Duty accounts on Skycoach , a marketplace where each Black Ops 7, Modern Warfare 4, or Warzone account listing shows whether it is ranked-ready, along with its level, Prestige, camo count, weapons, and the platforms it links to (PC, PlayStation, or Xbox). Skycoach has operated since 2020, and purchases come with buyer protection: a warranty period, a refund policy, and 24/7 support.

Black Ops 7 starts with placements. You must win three placement matches to receive a starting rank, and after each placement win, the Minimum Starting Rank updates to show a projection of where you’re expected to land.

After a Ranked Play win, you gain Skill Rating (SR), which sets your position on the ladder. The amount isn’t fixed: it depends on your match performance relative to the skill of the other players and the team’s margin of victory. The same factors affect SR deducted after a loss. As Activision’s ranked support page explains, the SR change depends on these match factors, so two wins during the same evening can award different amounts without an error in the display.

title: GTA 6 Pre-Loads Just Broke Virgin Media’s Broadband Records, Beating Arsenal and Fortnite
content:
GTA 6 pre-loads gave Virgin Media its busiest day on record, eight days before the game is even out. In a press release on 11 November , Virgin Media O2 said its UK broadband network set new highs for both peak traffic and total daily data on Tuesday 10 November. Peak traffic beat the previous record, set during Arsenal’s Champions League semi-final against Atlético Madrid, by 3.8%. Total data for the day was 4% higher than the previous best, which was set only on 1 November by the launch of Fortnite’s Chapter 7 Mini Season.

The rush started as soon as downloads opened. Between midnight and 1am UK time on 10 November, which is also midnight to 1am UTC in winter, Virgin Media recorded a 51.6% rise in broadband traffic compared with the same hour a week earlier. By 9am, the total data downloaded was 73.3% higher than over the same period on Tuesday 3 November. At 23:05 UTC, the network passed its previous record for an entire day’s data, with almost an hour of Tuesday still to go. Virgin Media O2 did not say how many customers pre-loaded the game, or publish its peak traffic in terabits per second.

Grand Theft Auto VI pre-loading is now available for everyone who has pre-ordered. If you still have yet to pre-order, now’s the time to make sure you're prepared for November 19: https://t.co/LUoPLobocD pic.twitter.com/TLtJUSFBwN

Virgin Media puts the game at 190GB, slightly less than the 212GB of free space we reported in our GTA 6 pre-load guide . The company says customers on its fastest Gig2 broadband service can download it in under 15 minutes. Our own calculation, at full line speed with no overheads, gives just under 13 minutes on a 2Gbps connection. On a 100Mbps line, the same download would take more than four hours, so many players will want to start well before launch day.

Pre-loading was always likely to strain networks, given how many people have already bought the game. GTA 6 has become the most pre-ordered game on record, with an estimated 9.69 million pre-orders, according to Sensor Tower. Rockstar’s own pre-load announcement also confirmed that the game targets 30 frames per second on consoles, which has caused a backlash among players . That debate has done little to slow the downloads, judging by Virgin Media’s figures.

Virgin Media O2 also published polling from Strand Partners, a member of the British Polling Council , which surveyed 520 UK adults who expect to play the game on 30 October. Nearly half (46%) said they expect to download GTA 6 before release day, and 45% expect to spend at least £50 on gaming kit, not counting the game. More than three-quarters (78%) have changed, or plan to change, their schedules to find time to play. Almost a quarter (23%) expect to stay up later or sleep less, and 22% plan to keep a whole weekend free.

title: Best Permanent Unlocks to spend Tokens on in Modern Warfare 4
content:
Classic Prestige has returned in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and that means that Permanent Unlock Tokens are coming back as well. If you’re unfamiliar with how Prestige Mode works, it resets your level back to one, but you receive a Permanent Unlock Token that you can use on any class item in multiplayer in exchange.

This is a huge benefit, as it lets you permanently unlock an item so you never have to unlock it again during the entire Prestige grind in Modern Warfare 4 . However, with so many items to choose from, which unlock gives you the best bang for your buck?

Below, we’ll give you five distinct class items in MW4 multiplayer that are most worth spending a Permanent Unlock Token on after you Prestige. The item list is in order from 1-5.

First on the list has to be the Stim, which is a piece of Tactical Equipment that quickly heals you back to full health when applied. The Stim is unlocked at level 47 in MW4 multiplayer, making it one of the final items you’ll unlock every single Prestige.

While there are other solid pieces of Tactical Equipment you can use until that level, once you get used to the Stim, there’s really no going back. The ability to get back into the fight instantly after being injured, compared to waiting for several seconds to recoup health, is one of the most important benefits of any item in multiplayer. If you use a Permanent Unlock Token on the Stim, your Tactical slot is pretty much set in stone on all loadouts in multiplayer.

Next up, we have the Axion assault rifle, which is unlocked at level 52. The Axion is one of the best assault rifles in Modern Warfare 4, and having it available for only three levels every Prestige is ultimately a waste of its potential. This is arguably a top meta weapon in multiplayer, so you’ll want it permanently unlocked as soon as possible.

title: How to get Ledge Hanging Kills in Modern Warfare 4
content:
Plenty of weapon camo challenges have become a pain in the sides of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 players everywhere, but none more than earning Ledge Hanging Kills. You need these kills specifically to unlock a camo for the Krait P68 pistol, and even though you only need 15 of them, it can feel like this challenge is impossible in multiplayer.

Fortunately, thanks to the release of some post-launch content in MW4, Ledge Hanging Kills aren’t an issue at all. So, if you want to see exactly how to earn Ledge Hanging Kills quickly, check out the guide below.

Ledge Hanging Kills require you to mantle halfway up an object, hang in the air, and then use your gun in a single hand to kill enemies. This is extremely difficult on its own, as there really aren’t that many objects that can be ledge-hung from on multiplayer maps in MW4.

However, there is one major exception to this rule. On the map Shipment, there are some red crates on the side of the map near the wooden pallets and ruined car. On either side of these red crates, you can jump up to the middle ledge and hang from it. You can see us performing the ledge hang from the red crate in the screenshot below.

From this position, you need to wait for enemies to come around the corner in front of you or from the crate’s exit right below you. Either way, you’ll be able to kill them fairly easily from this position, as no enemy expects you to be hanging off the side of the crate.

Of course, once you get a kill in this position, enemies will likely hunt you down, so it’s wise to move to different sides of the red crate to cause some confusion. In any case, though, you now have a bona fide spot to earn your Ledge Hanging Kills in Modern Warfare 4.

title: GTA 6 Pre-Orders Near 10 Million, and PS5 Is Crushing Xbox
content:
Grand Theft Auto 6 has taken close to 10 million pre-orders, according to Sensor Tower, and three in four of them are on PS5. Xbox Series X|S holds the other quarter ahead of the November 19 launch.

Research firm Sensor Tower has updated its GTA 6 sales tracker. It now counts 9.69 million pre-purchases, worth about $942 million in gross revenue. These are estimates. Neither Rockstar nor Take-Two has published a pre-order total.

At that level, the game is already past the 8 million pre-order mark linked to Cyberpunk 2077, the previous record.

PS5 accounts for 7.23 million of those pre-orders. Xbox Series X|S accounts for 2.46 million. That is a 75% to 25% split in favor of PlayStation.

Revenue follows the same pattern. PS5 pre-orders have brought in $703 million. Xbox Series X|S pre-orders have brought in $239 million.

Sony and Microsoft each keep about 30% of that money in platform fees. Both companies gain from the game's success, whatever the split.

content:

title: FaZe Clan’s 11.11.26 Teaser Is a $100,000 Call of Duty Tournament: What We Know About FaZe’s Return
content:
FaZe Clan’s cryptic “11.11.26” post now has its first answer: a $100,000 Call of Duty tournament. A few hours after the date appeared on FaZe’s X account on 9 November, the organisation released a trailer for the Flank Invitational, a two-day event on 11 and 12 November. It will be streamed on FaZe’s Twitch channel and on the channel of former Call of Duty pro ZooMaa. The teaser, FaZe’s first original post since March, had passed 600,000 views by Tuesday, and the account’s bio now reads only “11.11.26”.

ZooMaa’s tournament brand, The Flank, confirmed the details in a post on X headed “FAZE X THE FLANK”. It listed a “12 team fantasy draft” on 10 November, followed by the tournament itself on 11 and 12 November. ZooMaa, who still goes by FaZe ZooMaa on X, thanked “the team at @FaZeClan for getting this done” and said the teams would be drafted on Tuesday. FaZe has not said whether the tournament is the whole announcement, or the start of something bigger.

FaZe’s 41-second trailer opens with the words “FaZe Clan presents” over Call of Duty gameplay, and closes on a card reading “$100K Flank Invitational, November 11-12”. In between, it promises a double-elimination bracket across three modes: Hardpoint, Search and Destroy and Hijack. The maps shown carry the Korean street signs of Modern Warfare 4, the current Call of Duty, whose launch patch notes landed in October. No team list, player list or prize split had been published by Tuesday morning, India time.

The fantasy draft format has a history at The Flank. The Flank has run invitationals for Call of Duty League players since 2024, when ZooMaa announced a $100,000 series of Black Ops 6 events for pros. Its last edition, a $20,000 tournament in November 2025, was won by a four-player squad that included CDL player Dashy. In October, ZooMaa said in a clip shared by the account SpawnUp that this year’s event was “not even full teams bc they wouldn’t let me do it, again”, without naming who had blocked full rosters.

The teaser lands almost a year after FaZe’s creator side fell apart. In the last week of 2025, Adapt, JasonTheWeen, Lacy, Silky and Stable Ronaldo announced they were leaving, and FaZe veterans including Apex, Swagg and Rug followed. Bloomberg reported that Matt Kalish, the DraftKings co-founder who invested in FaZe Media in 2024, had asked creators to sign with his new agency, HardScope, or go independent, calling the old model “unsustainable”. On 28 December, FaZe said it was “heartbreaking to see this era of FaZe come to a close”, and that esports would become “our main focus moving forward”.

The main account has been close to silent since then, apart from a $10,000 Modern Warfare 2 trickshot challenge in March. Several of the departed creators moved on together, with Adapt, Silky, JasonTheWeen, Lacy, Marlon and Stable Ronaldo launching a new group, CORE, on 30 April. Co-founder Richard “Banks” Bengtson, who rebooted FaZe in 2024 before stepping down as chief executive in July 2025, replied to the teaser within an hour. “Although I have no part in whatever’s next for this brand, I will always root for its success,” he wrote , adding: “Thank you for changing my life.”

title: Call of Duty Chat Over FaceTime Sparks Bomb Scare and Evacuation at California’s Ontario Airport
content:
A Frontier Airlines plane and part of a terminal at California’s Ontario International Airport were evacuated on Sunday night, after a passenger mistook a man’s Call of Duty chat for a bomb threat. The man had been talking to a friend over FaceTime while the friend played the game, and another passenger heard him mention a bomb. A sweep of the aircraft found no explosive device, and police concluded that no crime had been committed, according to reports. The scare has since become one of the most shared gaming stories on X, where it reached the platform’s Today’s News section.

The incident took place at around 10pm local time on Sunday, 8 November, as the Frontier flight was preparing to depart. According to CBS Los Angeles , a passenger waiting on board heard someone say the words “bomb” and “explosion” and reported it to the crew. The California Post , which spoke to the Ontario Police Department, reported that the passenger heard the man say that “he had a bomb in his backpack”. Neither outlet reported the flight number or where the plane was heading.

Officers detained the man for questioning and confirmed that he was carrying a backpack, police spokesperson Denyse Quezada told the California Post. Passengers were taken off the plane, and the east side of Terminal 2 was cleared while flights were held. A bomb-sniffing dog team searched the aircraft and the surrounding area and found nothing dangerous, according to the same report. The Ontario Fire Department and a bomb squad also responded within minutes.

The man told investigators he had been on FaceTime with a friend who was playing the game online. “The friend was playing a video game called ‘Call of Duty,'” Quezada said, adding that “the subject’s statement was related to a video game and not an actual explosive”. Investigators contacted the friend, who backed up his account, and the man was released. Airport spokesperson Steve Lambert later said the investigation was complete and that operations at Ontario International Airport were resuming.

Reports differ on what happened to the man after he was cleared. CBS Los Angeles reported that all passengers, “including the detained individual”, got back on the plane for departure. The California Post said that everyone except the man was allowed to reboard. The Ontario Police Department had not posted about the incident on its official X account at the time of writing.

For Call of Duty players, talk of bombs and explosions is ordinary match commentary. Search and Destroy, one of the series’ best-known modes, is built entirely around planting or defusing a bomb, and explosives such as C4 and grenades are standard equipment. The mode is a fixture of competitive Call of Duty, and it returns in this year’s Modern Warfare 4, which drew mixed reactions at launch . Out of context, a single excited line from a match can sound alarming to anyone sitting nearby.

title: BIG débarque en RLCS
content:
Le mercato continue de s’agiter sur Rocket League, et cette fois, c’est un nouveau géant de l’esport allemand qui pourrait entrer dans la danse. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , BIG serait sur le point de recruter Damian « Tox » Schäfer, Matheo « osaft » Hapke et Nico « Nico » Majgren, trois joueurs libres ayant annoncé leur association le 23 octobre dernier. Une arrivée historique pour l’organisation berlinoise, fondée en 2017 et particulièrement connue pour ses équipes sur Counter-Strike et League of Legends. BIG a également connu le succès sur Fortnite, avec notamment un sacre à l’Esports World Cup, et souhaiterait désormais étendre ses activités à Rocket League.

Pour ses premiers pas sur la scène compétitive, BIG miserait sur un mélange d’expérience et de jeunesse. Présent en RLCS depuis 2020, Tox apporterait son vécu au groupe, après avoir notamment terminé deuxième des qualifications européennes de la dernière chance pour les Worlds 2026 avec Volare. À ses côtés, le Danois Nico, âgé de 17 ans, sort d’une saison encourageante chez NOVO Esports, tandis que son homologue allemand osaft, également âgé de 17 ans, s’est illustré sur la scène du 1v1. Demi-finaliste de l’European 1v1 Open en 2026, ce dernier avait notamment remporté le championnat d’Europe FIFAe avec Tox sous les couleurs de l’Allemagne. Le trio serait accompagné de l’entraîneur norvégien Kasper « Kasper » Sjølstad, ancien membre de WYLDE.

Cette nouvelle formation devrait rapidement avoir l’occasion de se mesurer aux meilleures équipes européennes. Le trio figure parmi les candidats les plus sérieux aux qualifications ouvertes du London Club Kick-Off, aux côtés notamment de Geekay Esports et d’Ikkaku, la nouvelle équipe formée par Rezears, yujin et le Français ExoTiiK. Un premier rendez-vous important pour BIG, qui ne fait pas partie des 20 organisations invitées à intégrer le programme de partenariat des RLCS 2027.

L’organisation allemande aurait d’ailleurs dû faire face à une concurrence importante pour s’attacher les services du trio. Toujours selon la même source, l’Eintracht Francfort, également présent sur League of Legends, aurait tenté sa chance, tout comme Five Fears et NOVO Esports. BIG semble finalement avoir pris l’avantage dans ce dossier, même si aucune signature n’a encore été officialisée. Avec un vétéran expérimenté et deux jeunes talents prometteurs, la structure berlinoise pourrait rapidement se faire une place parmi les outsiders de la scène européenne.
